decisionSource: Direct user instruction after absoltools.com production connection

sourceMeaning.title: Lead with the AbsolTools brand and identify the product as a browser-based set of text, data, and code tools.
sourceMeaning.description: Name the supported task families and state narrowly that tool inputs and results are not uploaded.
sourceMeaning.heading: Describe the main user outcome instead of the generic free-online-tools category.
sourceMeaning.intro: Direct users to the needed task and repeat the browser-processing boundary without making a general no-network claim.

implementationNotes: The change is a truthful brand-positioning rewrite, not a keyword-volume or ranking claim.
The no-upload statement applies only to tool inputs and results; it does not claim that ordinary hosting request metadata is absent.
Canonical URLs, locale routes, hreflang, sitemap entries, publication state, and structured-data shape remain unchanged.
The locale copy is source-meaning-aligned agent review and is not recorded as native-human approval.
The favicon keeps the existing blue identity color and replaces the obsolete 64 label with a font-independent AT monogram.
